However, structural issues exist: (1) The large spotted toy exhibits anatomical hybridization—horse-like body proportions with canine head features and ambiguous limb articulation where legs meet ground. (2) Dog figures lack fur texture entirely, appearing as smooth painted plastic, which while plausible for cheap toys, represents a biological authenticity gap. (3) Minor perspective distortion on leftmost red car's grille symmetry. No severe AI artifacts (melting, fusion, extra limbs) beyond the spotted toy's anatomical ambiguity. Overall authenticity remains high due to coherent scene composition and material consistency.
